ruleTimer: The timer starts when you press “Start test” and keeps running if you leave the page.

ruleTimeUp: When time runs out, your answers are submitted automatically.
ruleNoLimit: There is no time limit — take your time.
rulePolicyHighest: Your highest score across attempts counts.
rulePolicyAverage: The average of your attempts counts.
ruleSingleAttempt: You have a single attempt, so review your answers before submitting.
startBlocked: You can't start the test right now
